audit.whatIsWrong: win[3] said Tryndamere though its caption calls it a coin-flip farm stage; win[4] said Skill and win[5]/[6] said Tryndamere though all three captions describe Kayle kiting, out-trading and melting him through Undying Rage.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Tryndamere,Tryndamere,Tryndamere,Skill,Kayle,Kayle,Kayle at 53.06% over 490 games.
audit.corrected: Rows 3-6 aligned to the packet in both layers with ratings to match.

audit.why: Levels 1-3 his, level 6 (ranged form plus Divine Judgment), Nashor's, and level 16 are the right windows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Mocking Shout is never mentioned anywhere, despite being the one ability that punishes the kiting plan the whole page is built on.
audit.why: Riot text: Mocking Shout reduces surrounding champions' Attack Damage, and enemies with their backs turned to Tryndamere are also slowed — so it only slows you while you run away. 850 range, 14s.
audit.corrected: Added to mid: retreat facing him and it is only an AD cut, alongside Spinning Slash's 12s rank-1 cooldown as the bait window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal appears in the item line but never in the prose that tells you why.
audit.why: Flagged in missingInteractions: Bloodlust converts Fury into a heal on a 12s cooldown, which is what survives your chip.
audit.corrected: Added to late together with Undying Rage's 120s rank-1 cooldown and the instruction to keep attacking through the 5 seconds.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 you stabilize as W sustain and Q's armor/MR shred come online, but you still lose the straight spin-fight, so keep farming and wait for your spike. Six is your breath of air: Divine Ascent turns your autos ranged with AoE magic waves, and R gives you a few seconds of full invulnerability. When he E's in and spins, R through the burst, then kite backward and let your ranged autos plus E missing-health damage out-DPS his Fury. Bait his E, pop R as he commits, and walk him down once his spin damage runs dry.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 you stabilize as W sustain and Q's armor/MR shred come online, but you still lose the straight spin-fight, so keep farming and wait for your spike. Six is your breath of air: Divine Ascent turns your autos ranged with AoE magic waves, and R gives you a few seconds of full invulnerability. When he spins in, R through the burst, then kite — Mocking Shout only slows you while your back is turned, so retreat facing him and it is just an AD cut. Bait Spinning Slash, 12s at rank 1, and walk him down after.

edits.before: This is where you take over and never give it back. By 11 and especially 16 your autos fire fully ranged AoE waves and your E shreds percent-HP, so you kite his spin from outside his reach and melt him faster than his crit can finish you. Undying Rage only holds him at minimum HP for ~5s and he is killable the instant it ends — pop your own R to outlast his all-in, then keep attacking through his Rage so he dies the moment it drops. He is finite crit DPS; you are an uncapped hyper-carry. Just respect his E flank in fights and never get caught alone before R is up.
edits.after: This is where you take over and never give it back. By 11 and especially 16 your autos fire fully ranged AoE waves and your E shreds percent-HP, so you kite his spin from outside his reach and melt him faster than his crit can finish you. Grievous Wounds is not optional — Bloodlust turns his Fury into a heal every 12s. Undying Rage holds him alive for ~5s on a 120s rank-1 cooldown and he is killable the instant it ends, so keep attacking through it rather than backing off. Respect his E flank and never get caught alone before R is up.

edits.before: Unkillable 5s. Out-scale it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Unkillable ~5s, 120s at rank 1 — keep hitting him through it.

notes: Mocking Shout was absent from the whole page: it cuts AD in an 850 radius and slows only enemies with their backs turned, so retreating while facing him removes the slow entirely — the single most useful line for a kiting Kayle here. Undying Rage in wants.foe[2] is the correct name; the packet's suspectName is a false positive.
